scope: Twenty-one sentence-audited ljub- quantifier forms in the base papers; the semantically distinct adverb ljubazno is excluded as a negative control.
choice: Normalize all 21 arbitrary/any ljub- quantifiers to the established official libovolj- paradigm with sentence-specific gender, number, case and capitalization.
motivation: Every target denotes an arbitrary mathematical field, element, function, coefficient, domain, module, ring, system, set or factor. The surface ljub- has no official Interslavic arbitrary-quantifier headword and is dangerously adjacent to love/dear meanings, while EDIT-0071 already established libovolj- for the identical mathematical semantic slot.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining ljub- was rejected because it leaves a non-headword and potential false-friend family beside the 374-token established libovolj- paradigm.
Mapping the family to proizvolj- was rejected because EDIT-0071 already rejected that type-2 East/South-shaped alternative.
Blindly replacing every ljub- string was rejected because base line 6732 ljubazno means kindly and is semantically distinct editable prose; its orthographic status is outside this decision.
Using svobodny was rejected because free is not equivalent to arbitrary in these quantified mathematical statements.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official dictionary SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842 gives ID 22300 libovoljny for optional/arbitrary. It has no arbitrary-quantifier ljub- headword; its separate ljub- entry denotes darling/sweetheart.
evidence.edition_precedent: EDIT-0071 semantically audited and normalized 60 arbitrary/any mathematical quantifiers to libovolj-, raising the canonical family to 374 before this residual closure.
evidence.semantic_audit: All 21 contexts express unrestricted selection: any field, element, function, coefficient, domain, module, ring, system, set or factor. No affection, preference, optionality, proper name or quotation occurs.
evidence.cross_family_evidence: The selected libovolj- bridge is independently recognizable through Czech libovoln- and Slovene poljubn- controls already admitted in EDIT-0071; raw token volume was not used as a vote.
evidence.protected_domains: No target occurs in a comment, foreign-language/title argument, bibliography identity or TeX control name. One whole-token ljubazno at base line 6732 is a semantically excluded negative control and remains byte-exact; this decision makes no claim about its orthographic canonicality.

validation.coverage: The exact 12-form source histogram totals 21 sites, all in the base papers, and every site was replayed in sentence context.
validation.postcondition: All mapped arbitrary-quantifier ljub- forms are zero; canonical libovolj- rises from 374 to 395; the semantically excluded ljubazno negative control remains one.
validation.structure: Line count, raw brace counts, ordered TeX-control stream and math-delimiter stream are invariant; the other three source files are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: The exact successor bytes and SHA-256 were frozen by the deterministic applicator before source admission.
